I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Boundaries for the allotment of land bearimg names and containing following extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. MR/WLP/2019/123 dated 27.03.2019 made by the Surveyor General and situated in the Village of Denipitiya in Weligam Korala Minor Division, Divisional Secretary’s Division of Welipitiya, Matara District, Southern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Kingswood Park – Extent: 0.0209 Hectare North: Hatangewatta claimed by W.D. Chirantha and Kingswood Park claimed by Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha ; East; Kingswood Park claimed by Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha and the road; South: Kingswood Park which the claimant is not found ; West: Road. Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
